newsitem.title: THAILAND: Ailing Thai bank, Sitca in takeover talks.
newsitem.headline: Ailing Thai bank, Sitca in takeover talks.

text.p: SITCA Investment and Securities Plc will be invited on Thursday to start talks on taking over troubled Bangkok Bank of Commerce Plc, a panel supervising the ailing bank said on Wednesday.

"We will start the negotiations with SITCA first because we see the proposal of SITCA is more feasible than that of Nithipat group," the head of the control committee running the bank, Bajr Isarena, told reporters
However, SITCA said in a filing to the Thai stock exchange it had yet to receive an official letter from the group's controlling committee asking Sitca representatives to attend Thursday's meeting.
Nithipat Capital Plc and Sitca have been vying to take over the bank, which was placed under state control in May when it was found carrying non-performing loans of approximately 70 billion baht.
The rival groups are said to have offered to acquire 30 percent of the bank's stock at 10 baht per share.

Bajr said Sitca was preferred because its proposed handling of the non-performing loans appeared more attractive. "Both groups' rescue plans had similar ideas but the SITCA proposal will cause less of a burden on the government," he said.
